# truenas_sshkeypair (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing TrueNAS ssh keypair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve information about an existing SSH keypair
data "truenas_sshkeypair" "keypair" {
  name = "keypair"
}

output "sshkeypair_id" {
  value = data.truenas_sshkeypair.keypair.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the SSH keypair to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the SSH keypair.
